description: doctorSIM Agentic Commerce helps users browse supported countries, identify mobile carriers, compare mobile top-up prices, buy gift cards, choose travel eSIM plans, preview order totals, place confirmed orders, and check order status through ChatGPT. Regular users pay via a doctorsim.com payment link; PRO users can debit prepaid credits. Guest checkout does not require a doctorSIM login.
